svg.title: Epic Cogito Cloud + ZAVA Fabric: cross-tenant architecture and implementation overview, version 1
svg.desc: Native editable vector infographic inspired by the supplied architecture-and-implementation sample. Panel 1 preserves the original Epic operational EHR, Epic-managed Azure and Cogito Cloud, and ZAVA Fabric analytical data flow. Panel 2 expands the original ZAVA Azure security boundary with Entra identities, Conditional Access, hybrid connectivity, a virtual network, Private DNS, and a Private Endpoint. Panel 3 summarizes those same components in five implementation stages. All 19 original components are represented. Original PNG and earlier SVG are retained. This is a conceptual redraw, not a verified deployment or a claim that Microsoft Copilot generated this file.
svg.text: Secure identity. Private connectivity. Governed analytics. Clear ownership.
